operation.summary: Make a one-time link code for this Bridgit as the target (8 characters, 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries); needs a Device Domain Name; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: services
body.description: What the claiming Bridgit may use here: camera, gallery, interactions, location, mic, sounds, speaker, view (suggested: camera, mic, speaker, interactions, view); required for in

body.name: directions
body.description: ["in"] (default: the claiming Bridgit uses this one), ["out"] (this one uses it) or both

body.name: agents
body.description: For out: this Bridgit's control agent ids that may use the claiming Bridgit

operation.returns: code_id, code (K7QX-3MPA: give it with the name), name, expires_at, services, directions, link (bridgit://link#… for a QR code), name_lookup, how

directions.description: ["in"] (default: the claiming Bridgit uses this one), ["out"] (this one uses it) or both

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

services.description: What the claiming Bridgit may use here: camera, gallery, interactions, location, mic, sounds, speaker, view (suggested: camera, mic, speaker, interactions, view); required for in

agents.description: For out: this Bridgit's control agent ids that may use the claiming Bridgit
